column1: # Charged items (OSRS Wiki costs, RuneLite 1.13.1 gameval ids). Order matters: Check text matches the first row.
# Every id is written number=GAMEVAL_NAME; ChargeCatalogueTest checks each one against RuneLite's constants.
# key, name, Check supported, family, estimate action, units per priced item, Check pattern (key, count group,
#   single-charge group), cast graphics, attack animations, recipe per use (qty*item), fractional part per use
#   (num/den*item), other menu names (;), item ids. "-" means none.
# Notes: tridents and rune-fed casts (shadow, sanguinesti, warped, venator) count charges; each cast spends the recipe.
#   The echo venator (ornament kit) reads as its own bow. The Eye of Ayak is tear- or rune-fed (code keeps both modes).
#   The scythe Check reads charges (remaining|left), including holy/sanguine variants, and books its measured blood
#   runes; its 1/100 vial per charge stays estimate-accrued. Ates is tear-fed teleport charges; a tome page gives 20
#   charges; a crystal shard gives 100. Saeldor spends one charge per attack, hit or miss; its Check books measured
#   shards. Blood fury spends one charge per successful melee hit, whether it heals or not.
#   Revenant weapons spend one revenant ether per attack; their Check says only "bow", "sceptre" or
#   "chainmace", so the clicked weapon names the row. Kharedst's memoirs (and the Book of the Dead) spend one
#   law, body, mind and soul rune per teleport; they are charged at the Old Memorial.
#   The Toxic staff of the dead and the serpentine, tanzanite and magma helms Check as "Scales: N", so the
#   clicked item names the row; they count only what Checks measure (no estimate between Checks).
# Sailors' amulet: 1 law + 10 water feed 10 charges, 1 per teleport (OSRS Wiki; the click options are the destination names).
# Bryophyta's staff holds nature runes; an alchemy or superheat cast with it worn spends one (OSRS Wiki,
#   owner recording 2026-10-09: "The staff currently has no charges.", "Your Bryophyta's staff now has 1000 charges.").
# Crystal armour and the crystal shield are load-costed (owner 2026-10-12, committed_loads.tsv):
#   shards used on a piece book as a counted Supplies spend at load, because a revert keeps the
#   seeds but always loses the loaded charges. They keep no Check comparison.
# The ring of suffering (committed_loads.tsv): rings of recoil load as charges, noted or unnoted
#   (noted canonicalises to the ring of recoil); a discharge never refunds them (OSRS Wiki, 2026-10-12).
# The Tonalztics of Ralos: one sunfire splinter per throw; uncharge refunds the splinters, so the
#   load is neutral and only Checks measure the throws (OSRS Wiki transcript, owner 2026-10-12).
# The water and earth tomes: a page gives 20 charges; the page names the tome, and a bare
#   "your tome" line resolves through the clicked item (owner 2026-10-12).
# The bracelet of ethereum (committed_loads.tsv): revenant ether loads as charges; an uncharge
#   destroys the stored ether, so the load books at charge (OSRS Wiki, owner 2026-10-12).
# Bone staff: chaos runes are its charges (Uncharge refunds them, so the load is neutral); one per cast; Check wording unverified.
# Crystal tools: shard-fed (100 per shard), 1 charge per resource; a dismantle loses the shard charges, so the load books (committed_loads.tsv).
# Echo boots: echo crystals feed 6,000 recoil charges each; a Revert never returns them, so the load books.
# Slayer's staff (e): the enchantment grants 2,500 charges and a Revert loses what remains, so the load books.
# Infernal tools: a smouldering stone (or a spare dragon tool) feeds 5,000 charges; they can never be reverted, so the load books.
